_comment: The street the Cruise screen is set in. street_<light>.kn5 are built by tools/StreetScene (prepare_street.py, then
StreetSceneBuilder) from Poly Haven's Pretville Street panorama, projected from where it was shot: the middle of the
scene, 1.7 m up. Positions are metres from there, headings degrees about the vertical (0 faces +z, down the long
street; the curb and the pink building are on the right of a car facing it).
player: where the player's car is parked, a little off the middle towards the curb so the rival's lane is clear.
laneOffset: how far to the player's left the rival's car drives, centre to centre.
rivalStop: where the rival's centre stops, metres ahead of the player's centre (negative is behind).
approachFrom / leaveTo: how far behind the rival starts and how far ahead it goes out of sight.
sun: the key light's direction, towards the sun, as measured in the panorama (prepare_street.py's light.json).
lights: the renderer's light for each light of the day; colours are r, g, b 0-255. cubemapAmbient is the fill
the renderer lights cars with from its reflections: anything over 0 is a bright white fill whatever the hour, so
dusk and night have 0, and the cars take the ambient colours instead. lamps are street lights lit at night,
title: Pretville Street
credit: Pretville Street HDRI by Dimitrios Savva and Jarod Guest, Poly Haven (CC0)
